# Assessment Overview

This directory contains supplementary assessment documents generated for this report.

1. [architecture-diagram.md](./architecture-diagram.md) - Architecture diagram and component relationships
2. [dependency-map.md](./dependency-map.md) - Dependency categorization and compatibility observations
3. [api-service-contracts.md](./api-service-contracts.md) - API endpoints and service communication contracts
4. [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Data model, repository patterns, and persistence boundaries
5. [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, profiles, and sensitive settings inventory
6. [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows and business decision logic
